name: unpack_backward_run_length

name: step_byte_once_with_wrap

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0000
name: initialise_narrator_device_unit
description: Allocates a unit structure for the narrator device, initialises its linked lists and fields, allocates a second block for a request, and links the two together. It returns minus one only when both allocations succeed and zero otherwise.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:00D0
name: queue_narrator_request_or_fail
description: Handles a narrator request: when the input value is zero and a unit is already active, it fills the request record with default pitch, rate and volume and links it. Otherwise it allocates a message, and any failure records an error code on the request.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:00DE
name: start_or_queue_narrator_request
description: Starts a narrator request when no speech is in progress, allocating a message and recording an error code if the allocation fails. Otherwise it increments the request counters, fills the request record with default speech settings, and clears a busy flag.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0110
name: allocate_narrator_message_or_fail
description: Allocates a message for a narrator request and stores the new pointer in the unit. On success it counts the request and fills its default speech settings, and on failure it records an error code instead.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:014E
name: fill_narrator_request_defaults
description: Stores the value passed in the data register as the unit's current request and increments the request counters. It then fills the request record with default pitch, rate and volume and clears a busy flag.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:01A0
name: store_request_status_byte
description: Stores the low byte of the data register as the request's status and sets its completion marker to minus one. It is the final step when a narrator request ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:01AE
name: requeue_or_update_narrator_request
description: Clears the request's flag and either copies the current speech mode from the unit into it or puts the request back on the unit's waiting list. When the unit has no pending request it records a status code and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:01E0
name: queue_narrator_request_on_unit
description: Places the request on the unit's waiting list, or when it already matches the pending request, copies the current speech mode into it. A nesting counter is adjusted around the list update.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0222
name: update_request_mode_or_requeue
description: Copies the current speech mode into the request when it differs from the unit's setting, otherwise it requeues the request on the unit's list while adjusting the nesting counter.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:026A
name: copy_speech_mode_nibbles
description: Copies the speech mode byte from the source record into the request, splitting it into low and high nibbles stored separately. It clears the status field and then calls a library routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0290
name: validate_and_apply_speech_parameters
description: Checks each speech parameter in the request, such as rate, pitch, volume and the mode flags, against its allowed range and copies the valid values into the unit. It fails and finishes the request when any value is out of range.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:02F2
name: apply_speech_parameters_checked
description: Decrements the request counter, then checks the speech parameters in the request and applies each valid value to the unit. It jumps to the finishing step when a value is out of range.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:030C
name: finish_narrator_request_and_notify
description: Removes matching requests from the unit's waiting list by calling a routine for each match, then decrements the active count. When the count reaches zero it calls library routines to shut the unit down and returns the status of the last call.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0332
name: decrement_active_count_and_shutdown
description: Decrements the active count, and when it reaches zero calls two library routines to shut the unit down. If a flag bit is set it calls one further routine and returns its result.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:036E
name: dispatch_narrator_mode_handler
description: Uses the mode value stored in the request to call one of eight handlers from a table. A mode outside that range records an error code and calls the finishing routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:038E
name: unlink_request_or_mark_pending
description: Removes the request from its doubly linked list and calls library routines to release it when its status word is zero. Otherwise it sets the pending bit in the request's flags and returns zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:03AE
name: unlink_request_and_release
description: Removes the request from its doubly linked list, calls library routines to release it, and returns the entry's stored value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:03F4
name: dispatch_request_by_type_code
description: Dispatches a narrator request according to its type code: some codes set a busy flag and call library routines, while others check the pending list or report an error when the device is busy. Unknown codes fall through to a default library call.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:046C
name: set_state_seven_and_finish
description: Clears a flag in the unit, marks the unit with state code seven and sets its busy bit, then calls library routines and finishes the request with a status of zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:04A8
name: set_state_six_and_busy
description: Sets a flag bit in the unit, marks the unit with state code six and its busy bit, calls a library routine, and finishes the request with a status of zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:04E6
name: bracket_two_calls_with_flag
description: Sets bit 7 of the unit's flags, calls two routines, then clears that bit again so both calls run with the flag set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0510
name: bracket_one_call_with_flag
description: Sets bit 7 of the unit's flags, calls a routine and clears the bit again, then sets the request status to zero and calls a second routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0540
name: flush_request_list_entries
description: Calls a routine for the unit's pending request if one exists, then calls a routine for each entry on the request list while holding the nesting counter. It returns the status from the last call.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0570
name: decrement_active_count_only
description: Decrements the active count in the device data and, when it reaches zero, sets the global control word to a fixed value. It has no other effect.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0584
name: abort_pending_request
description: If the request is the active one, it marks the request with a flag bit. Otherwise it searches the waiting list and, when it finds the request, unlinks it and sets its status to an abort code, then adjusts the active count.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:05B0
name: remove_request_from_list
description: Searches the device's request list for the given request. When found it unlinks the request, sets its status to an abort code, decrements the active count and calls a library routine; when not found it only decrements the count.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:05BE
name: unlink_request_mark_aborted
description: Unlinks the request from its list, sets its status to an abort code, decrements the active count, and calls a library routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:05E8
name: decrement_active_count_only
description: Decrements the active count in the device data and, when it reaches zero, sets the global control word to a fixed value. It has no other effect.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0600
name: fail_request_with_status_code
description: Sets the request's status to a fixed error code and calls a library routine. It is the failure exit used when a request cannot be handled.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:060C
name: complete_request_with_zero_status
description: Sets the request's status to zero to mark it complete and calls a library routine to finish it.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0616
name: clear_unit_flag_and_status
description: Clears bit 0 of the unit's flags and zeroes the request's status byte, then calls a library routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0710
name: apply_speech_parameters_from_start
description: Checks each speech parameter in the request against its allowed range, starting from the first one, and applies the valid values to the unit. It fails and finishes the request when any value is out of range.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0744
name: apply_speech_parameters_from_pitch
description: Applies the request's speech parameters beginning with the pitch value, checking each against its allowed range. The first value out of range ends the request.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:075E
name: apply_speech_parameters_from_rate
description: Applies the request's speech parameters beginning with the rate value, using the same range checks. The first value out of range ends the request.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:077E
name: apply_speech_parameters_from_mode
description: Applies the request's remaining parameters beginning with the mode values, checking each range before storing it in the unit.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0798
name: apply_speech_parameters_from_flag
description: Stores a flag value from the request, then applies the remaining parameters beginning with the volume range, jumping to the finishing step when a check fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:07AC
name: apply_speech_parameters_from_volume
description: Applies the request's parameters starting from the volume-range value, checking each against its range before storing it and finishing the request on failure.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:07C6
name: check_level_then_apply_parameters
description: Checks a level value against its maximum of 64. Above that maximum it finishes the request with a status derived from a library call; otherwise it stores the level and applies the remaining speech parameters.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0846
name: start_speech_and_finish_request
description: Starts speech output through library calls, then completes the request. A zero result is recorded as success, a negative result as zero, and a positive result as an error code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:08E6
name: store_request_result_and_status
description: Copies a result field from the request into its output slot, stores the status byte passed in the data register, and calls a library routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:08EE
name: clear_result_and_store_status
description: Clears the request's result field to zero, stores the status byte passed in the data register, and calls a library routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0900
name: find_text_split_point
description: Scans a text buffer backwards for a comma or hyphen and, failing that, for a space near three quarters of the way along, recording that position as the split point. If no break is found it splits at half the buffer length.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0930
name: find_space_split_point
description: Looks for a space near three quarters of the way along a text buffer and records it as the split point, falling back to half the buffer length when no space is found. It then finishes the request with a status based on a library call.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0956
name: split_at_half_length
description: Records half the buffer length as the split point, then finishes the request and stores a status taken from a library call.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0CF0
name: initialise_speech_channel_state
description: Clears the channel's flag and count fields, sets default channel values, copies two settings from the request, and calls library routines. It allocates a buffer for the channel and links it in, returning zero if the allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0D46
name: select_speech_table_entry
description: Looks up a routine in a table using the request's selector byte. An empty table slot records error code 250 and a failed allocation records error code 254; otherwise it allocates a buffer and stores the selected routine in the channel.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0D68
name: copy_channel_template_blocks
description: Stores the buffer pointer in the channel, then copies a 34-word template into the buffer and a second area, repeating once for each channel slot. The selector byte sets the number of repetitions.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0DBE
name: allocate_and_copy_channel_template
description: Allocates a buffer for the channel and, when that succeeds, copies the channel template into it once for each channel slot. It returns error code 254 when the allocation fails and zero otherwise.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0DDE
name: copy_channel_template_to_buffer
description: Copies the channel template into the given buffer, repeating a 34-word block once for each channel slot, and returns zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0E14
name: release_channel_buffers_with_status
description: Sets the channel mode to nine, frees the channel's two buffers when they are allocated, clears the length field, and returns a fixed status value of two.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0E24
name: release_channel_buffers
description: Sets the channel mode to nine, frees the channel's two buffers when they are allocated, clears the length field, and returns the register values unchanged.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0F68
name: translate_text_to_phonemes
description: Returns at once when the channel's length is below one. Otherwise it resets the phoneme output fields and walks the input text, matching two-character sequences against a rule table and emitting phoneme codes until the text ends or a hash character is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0F72
name: translate_text_to_phonemes
description: Resets the phoneme output fields and walks the input text, matching two-character sequences against a rule table of about 112 entries and emitting phoneme codes until the text ends or a hash character is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0FE4
name: emit_phoneme_codes_for_text
description: Continues phoneme translation: digit characters are converted to numeric phoneme codes and other characters are copied to the output, until the text ends or the length limit is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0FF8
name: continue_phoneme_translation_after_match
description: Continues phoneme translation after a rule match: a digit range is converted to numeric phoneme codes and the rule flags decide whether the character is copied, until the text ends or the length limit is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1026
name: copy_phoneme_characters_with_marks
description: Copies the current character into the phoneme output buffer and sets marker flags for control codes five and six. It stops and records its position when the buffer reaches 511 characters.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1064
name: set_phoneme_mark_flags
description: Sets a marker flag on the current phoneme for control codes five and six, then continues the text scan. Any other code returns to the main translation loop.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1074
name: set_phoneme_mark_flag_six
description: Sets the marker flag for control code six on the previous phoneme entry and resumes the rule match over the text. Other codes continue down the translation path.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1084
name: store_phoneme_code_with_limit
description: Writes the phoneme code into the output buffer and advances the length. When the buffer passes 511 entries it records the position and returns, otherwise it continues matching the text.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10AA
name: resume_phoneme_text_matching
description: Resumes the rule match at the current text position, checking the position against the stored limit before matching the next two characters. Special codes in the high range are handled separately.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10C2
name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: The decompiled body is empty apart from a return, so this routine has no visible behaviour. It is an empty stub in the program.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10CC
name: terminate_phoneme_output
description: Appends a sentinel value of 255 to each of the parallel phoneme arrays and stores the final length. The length is recorded in the channel only when the output is long enough.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10D8
name: pad_and_terminate_phoneme_output
description: Appends the sentinel terminator to the phoneme output, first padding with a code of four when the output has more than three entries. It stores the length in the channel when it is long enough.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1122
name: store_phoneme_output_length
description: Stores the current output position in the channel's length field and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:112C
name: mark_phoneme_context_flags
description: Walks the phoneme output and sets a context marker bit on entries based on the class flags of the surrounding phonemes, including the preceding one or two codes. It stops at the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:118E
name: propagate_phoneme_context_flags
description: Walks forward through the phoneme output, setting context marker bits on the preceding entries for each phoneme whose class flags match, and returns at the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:119E
name: mark_phoneme_class_boundaries
description: Walks forward through the phoneme output from a stored class value and sets marker bits on the entries two and three places back. It returns at the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:11BC
name: flag_phoneme_runs_with_markers
description: Walks the phoneme output and marks the start of each run of phonemes with bit 7, copying a flag bit from the first entry across the run. Codes 24 and 23 are skipped as separators.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:121A
name: spread_flags_across_phoneme_run
description: Marks a run of phoneme entries with bit 7 and spreads a flag bit from the run's first entry across it. The midpoint of the run decides how far the spread reaches, and separator codes are skipped.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1262
name: copy_run_flags_to_phonemes
description: Marks the current phoneme and, when a run start is known, copies a flag bit from the run's first entry across the remaining run length. A further pass sets bit 6 across the run when a mode bit is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:12CC
name: spread_run_flags_forward
description: Computes the run length from the current position and spreads the flag bit of the run's first phoneme across it, marking separators along the way. The walk continues until the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:12D6
name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: The decompiled body is a bare return with no work, so the routine has no visible behaviour. It is an empty stub in the program.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:12D8
name: match_phoneme_pattern_rule
description: Compares the phoneme output at the current position with a pattern, where a sentinel byte in the pattern matches anything. It advances through the output and returns the position when it reaches the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1324
name: match_rule_pattern_at_position
description: Checks the phoneme rule at the current position against its pattern bytes, treating a sentinel as a wildcard. When the rule matches it calls a routine and advances, and when it fails the routine returns to its caller.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:13C2
name: scan_rule_table_for_match
description: Scans forward through the rule table testing each position against the pattern, where a sentinel byte matches anything. Matching positions call a routine and the scan continues until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:13D6
name: scan_rule_table_from_index
description: Continues scanning the rule table from the index in the data register, checking each position against the pattern. Matching positions are handled and the scan carries on until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:13E4
name: test_phoneme_flag_mask
description: Walks a table of flag entries, inverting or masking each value according to its control bits, and returns once the tested bit is set. It stops at the table end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1412
name: insert_phoneme_at_position
description: Shifts the phoneme output buffers right by one place from the given position, inserts the marker value there and clears the vacated slots. It does nothing once the output has reached the 512-entry limit.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1428
name: shift_phoneme_buffers_right
description: Increments the output length and shifts the phoneme output buffers right by one place, inserting the given marker at the current position and clearing the vacated slots.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1454
name: run_fixed_routine_sequence
description: Calls seven routines in a fixed sequence and returns zero. Each call is one step of the same set sequence.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1472
name: clear_rule_table_flags
description: Walks a table of eight-byte records up to the sentinel, clearing the last byte of each record, and then sets the same byte in the terminating entry to a fixed value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:148A
name: clear_flags_until_matching_entry
description: Clears the last byte of each eight-byte record until it reaches a record whose first byte matches the data register, then sets the byte in the channel's entry to a fixed value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1492
name: average_neighbour_phoneme_flags
description: Walks the phoneme output and, for code 23, averages the small numeric values of the two preceding entries. Other codes with a flag bit set write a derived value into the following entry, and the pass stops at the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:14B2
name: apply_phoneme_rule_flags
description: Applies per-phoneme rule flags: code 23 averages the two preceding values, and other codes copy a selected flag into the output entry according to their class bits. It returns at the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:14E6
name: write_phoneme_output_entry
description: Writes the output entry for the current phoneme from a lookup table, then sets a low class code of 4, 5 or 6 derived from the following phoneme's flags. It moves on through the output until the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1510
name: write_phoneme_entry_from_flags
description: Writes a phoneme entry from the lookup table indexed by the data register and sets the class code derived from the next phoneme's flags, then advances. Code 23 is averaged with its neighbours.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1558
name: set_phoneme_class_code
description: Sets the low class code of the current output entry to 4, 5 or 6 based on the flag bits in the data register, then advances. Code 23 is averaged with its neighbours and the sentinel ends the pass.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1564
name: set_low_class_code
description: Sets the low class code of the current output entry to 4, or to 5 when bit 5 of the flag value is set, then advances through the phoneme output.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1572
name: set_low_class_code_four
description: Sets the low class code of the current output entry to 4 and advances through the phoneme output, averaging code 23 with its neighbours as it goes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:157C
name: write_phoneme_frames_until_sentinel
description: Walks the phoneme output and writes frame entries from a lookup table for each phoneme, skipping code 23 and setting class bits along the way. It returns at the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1586
name: allocate_phoneme_frame_buffers
description: Adds up the masked values of the phoneme output to get a total, then stores that total and a buffer size of eight bytes per unit plus eight. It allocates the frame buffer and, when a flag is set, a second buffer, returning early if an allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:15A0
name: allocate_frame_buffers_for_size
description: Stores the given count and a buffer size of eight bytes per unit plus eight, allocates the frame buffer, and when a flag is set allocates a second buffer. It returns without the second buffer if the first allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:15C2
name: store_frame_buffer_pointer
description: Stores the given buffer pointer as the channel's frame buffer, then allocates a second buffer when a flag is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:15E0
name: build_phoneme_frame_output
description: Builds the frame output for each phoneme from the lookup tables, adjusting the values according to the neighbouring class bits and the mode flag. It writes the results into the frame buffers until the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:160A
name: adjust_phoneme_frame_values
description: Applies the lookup adjustments to each phoneme frame, adding a small offset to the stored values for stressed classes and capping one value at 31. It writes the adjusted frames until the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:16B8
name: interpolate_phoneme_frame_values
description: Interpolates frame values between neighbouring phonemes and writes the results into the output buffers, repeating for each frame until the sentinel value. It steps through the frame positions held in the channel.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:172A
name: compute_phoneme_transition_values
description: Compares neighbouring phoneme values and fills a short run of transition values for each pair, stepping through five positions and choosing between the two neighbours at each step. It stops at the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1762
name: smooth_phoneme_transition_values
description: Compares neighbouring phoneme values and smooths the transition between each pair, stepping through a short run of positions. Values are blended from the two neighbours until the sentinel value ends the pass.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:177A
name: smooth_phoneme_frame_steps
description: Smooths the phoneme transition values in steps, comparing each pair of neighbours and writing a blended value at each position. It stops at the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:17A8
name: interpolate_between_neighbour_values
description: Blends each frame value toward its neighbour by a weighted fraction using a five-bit shift, and advances through the frames until the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:17D2
name: advance_to_next_frame_record
description: Advances to the next frame record and repeats the pass, checking each phoneme code against the sentinel value. It returns when the sentinel is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:17D6
name: total_frame_durations
description: Walks the phoneme output and the frame list, advancing the frame pointer by eight bytes per unit of each phoneme's duration, and returns the accumulated value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:181E
name: compute_frame_neighbour_values
description: Computes each frame's values from the current phoneme and its neighbours, applying class-based overrides, and writes the results into the frame record. It returns at the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1844
name: compute_frame_neighbour_mix
description: Computes a blended value for each frame from the neighbouring phoneme values, zeroing it for flagged entries, and stores the result in the frame record.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:186E
name: compute_frame_values_by_class
description: Computes frame values for each phoneme class, mixing in the neighbouring values and clearing them where the class flags require. It writes the values to the frame buffer until the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1880
name: compute_frame_flag_values
description: Computes per-frame flag values from the current and neighbouring phoneme entries, setting a secondary marker when the class bits match. It writes the results into the frame record.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:18B8
name: fill_frame_transition_values
description: Fills the transition values for a frame by stepping down through the values and blending them toward a target, using a per-frame step. It writes the results into the frame record and stops at the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:190E
name: fill_frame_records_with_value
description: Writes a run of four-word frame records, clearing each one and storing the given value into its value field unless the high flag is set, then walks the phoneme output to the next entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:191A
name: fill_frame_record_run
description: Clears a run of four-word frame records and fills the value field of each one, then advances the phoneme output to the next entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:193A
name: fill_frame_records_for_phonemes
description: Walks the phoneme output and writes a block of frame records for each phoneme, clearing each record and storing its value field. It returns zero when the sentinel value is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1946
name: fill_frame_records_with_neighbours
description: Walks the phoneme output and writes frame records using the neighbouring phoneme values, clearing each record first. It returns zero at the sentinel value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1966
name: clear_counted_frame_records
description: Clears a counted run of four-word frame records and stores the value field in each record whose high flag is clear, then steps to the next phoneme.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1970
name: compact_frame_arrays
description: Copies the phoneme and frame arrays into compact form, skipping entries whose flag bit is set, until the sentinel value. It keeps the parallel arrays in step.
